title: Dori va vitamin: posilkada qancha mumkin
caption: 💊 Dori va vitamin buyurtma qilyapsizmi? Miqdorga qarang Bunday posilkalarda pul emas, dona hisoblanadi. Norma oshsa — posilka to'xtaydi. 💊 Dori vositalari • 10 xil nomgacha • har bir nomdan 5 qadoqgacha 🌿 BAD (vitamin, omega-3, kollagen va h.k.) • 10 xil nomgacha, jami 3 kg gacha • har bir nomdan faqat 1 qadoq ⚠️ Ko'p uchraydigan xato: iHerb yoki Amazon'dagi «2 ta oling — arzonroq» aksiyasi. BAD uchun ikkinchi qadoq normadan tashqarida qoladi. ✅ Buyurtmadan oldin 1. Savatdagi har bir nomni va qadoqlar sonini sanang 2. Dori va BAD ni alohida hisoblang — normalari har xil 3. Shubha bo'lsa — buyurtmani ikki oyga bo'ling 📄 Asos: VM 191-son, 08.06.2016, Nizom 5-band; VM 244-son, 19.04.2025, 1-ilova — lex.uz 📲 Savatingizni ilovada tekshiring ➖➖➖ @Pochtam_shopo #taqiq
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Clean, modern 3D-minimal style, calm and trustworthy. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape behind the upper half.

1) Top-left: a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold text "#taqiq".
2) Center: an open matte cardboard parcel with several small medicine boxes and supplement bottles neatly lined up beside it; one extra identical bottle stands apart with a small amber warning tag, and a tiny indigo counter badge shows numbers. Render it as a soft 3D clay illustration with matte surfaces in white and indigo (#4F46E5) with small touches of emerald green (#059669); soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, generous space around it.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold near-black (#11111B) headline, at most two lines: "Dori va vitamin: qancha mumkin?"
4) Under the headline, a smaller medium-grey line: "Pul emas, dona hisoblanadi"
5) Bottom, above a thin light divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo".

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
notes: VM 191 uchun lex.uz dagi aniq havolani qo'shing (Claude muhitidan lex.uz ochilmadi). Normalar BRIEF.md dagi tekshirilgan faktlardan: dori — 10 nom, har biridan 5 qadoq (VM 191, Nizom 5-band); BAD — 10 nom, 3 kg, har nomdan 1 qadoq (VM 244, 1-ilova). «Buyurtmani ikki oyga bo'ling» maslahati — BAD normasi oyga yoki jo'natmaga bog'liqligini tekshiring.
